description: Capabilities granted to the About window. Its own file rather than adding the label to `default`, which would hand a box that shows a version number the same reach as the window that drives Docker. It needs the core runtime — the same document is loaded, so Vue, the router and `invoke` all have to work — and nothing else: `open_in_browser` is one of this app's own commands, and those are gated by the command registry rather than by a plugin permission.
